meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: External debt of India, quarterly, rupees (DBIE report 660)
meta.coverage: India's external debt at the end of every quarter since September 1999, in rupees, by creditor and instrument
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 660, ₹ crore, stocks at the end of each quarter plotted at the quarter's first month, by creditor (lines E.1...). The same table's borrower-by-maturity layout (from March 2021) is external-debt-sector-inr. The rupee value of dollar debt moves with the exchange rate. The table's ratio lines are left out (scaled by a crore, and amounts in place of ratios in some 2017-19 quarters); the ratios are in external-debt-annual. The table's US$ column is missing from the Data Bank mirror; the dollar series is external-debt.
